procedures.trigger: Build/test/package/deploy automation is added or changed.
steps: Map current pipeline stages, artifacts, environments, identities, and rollback path.
Define desired change and failure boundary.
Use immutable artifact identity and explicit config/secret inputs.
Exercise dry-run/test environment and negative/failure behavior.
Verify rollback/recovery mechanics and exact artifact continuity.
Hand production reliability/security/release-policy decisions to owning professions.
stop_conditions: Destructive infrastructure effect is not understood.
Rollback path required by continuity is absent.

procedures.trigger: A release needs repeatable automated promotion.
steps: Return evidence to Integration/Release and SRE for their separate acceptance decisions.
stop_conditions: Target environment drift exceeds declared policy.
